cohort: Forty-six COVID-19-positive pregnant patients who developed adverse events following COVID-19 therapeutics were included in the study.
finding: The most common maternal adverse event was elevated serum alanine aminotransferase, while non-reassuring fetal heart patterns were the most common fetal adverse event observed after administration of COVID-19 therapeutics.
mod_finding: Emergent or unplanned cesarean sections were reported as an adverse event following the administration of several COVID-19 therapeutics.
